spans.text: Within the underground passage, the only sounds that could be heard was that of light footsteps and fabric rubbing against itself.
I can sense your pace slowing down. Is something the matter?
No, it's just that this place is getting darker and darker... I'm adjusting my night vision optics' parameters...
Understood. I'll slow down and wait for you.
The passage here is different from the outside.
Is it a matter of the construction materials?
It just feels a little different to the touch.
This sector ought to be nothing but ancient architecture. It shouldn't be renovated, unlike the outside.
It's very likely that this deeper portion might have been preserved as a relic, and I found a lot of hidden doors that are only big enough to admit one person...
I've already recorded the positions of those hidden doors we passed. We might be able to use them in our retreat.

I've been making a note of them myself. According to the parts of the map that we've already explored, it's very likely that these hidden doors are all interlinked, forming a network of secret passages.
When you think about it, this place isn't just a maze, it's practically an anthill... Are you sure those passages won't collapse on us?
They won't. They may be old, but their construction is solid. They were built using techniques we hardly see nowadays.
I can't see any reason why they would collapse, barring an earthquake or a large explosion from below.
Hopefully things won't get so bad that we'll have to duck into these filthy hidden passages.
